KALERU ABHIRAM Full Stack Engineer +91 7993119262 • abhiramkaleru@gmail.com • Hyderabad, India https://www.linkedin.com/in/abhiram-kaleru-a81281246 • https://abhiram-portfolio-04.web.app

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Full Stack Engineer (Backend-focused) with 2.3+ years building scalable fintech and distributed systems. Leading system design for a live crypto platform with 10,000+ users and 80,000+ daily events. Core expertise: Node.js, FastAPI, BullMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Recently extended platform capabilities with a production RAG-based AI support chatbot LangChain, Gemini, Qdrant vector database deployed live on jaimax.com. Proven track record shipping end-to-end products from architecture to zero-downtime production deployments.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Reduced transaction failure rate by 30% — designed event-driven architecture with BullMQ, retry logic, and idempotency. • Improved API response time by 50% and cut DB load by 40% — implemented Redis caching layer across high-traffic endpoints. • Scaled platform to 10,000+ active users processing 80,000+ daily events — zero-downtime AWS infrastructure (EC2, ALB, VPC, CloudFront).

Eliminated manual KYC verification entirely by building an OCR-based automated KYC validation system using Tesseract OCR / Google Cloud Vision across multiple verification workflows.

Engineered three-phase JMC Mining System (Normal , Recovery , Resurrection) — zero revenue loss during any outage cycle. • Sole engineer for JAIMAX FORCE HRMS — full backend , frontend delivered independently, used daily by the entire organization. • Built production RAG AI support chatbot (LangChain , Gemini , Qdrant) — deployed live on jaimax.com, eliminating manual support queries with 24/7 instant AI responses.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Core:

Node.js, FastAPI, BullMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL,MongoDB, AWS, React.js, Next.js

Languages:

JavaScript (ES6+), Python, HTML5, CSS3

Backend:

Express.js, REST APIs, MVC, Microservices, Event-Driven Systems, SOLID, ACID

Frontend:

React.js, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Redux Toolkit, RTK Query

Databases:

PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Cloud Firestore — Polyglot Persistence, H/V Scaling

Msg Brokers:

BullMQ, Redis Queues, Worker Threads, Cron Jobs, Event-Driven Architecture (DLQ, Retry, Idempotency)

Cloud/DevOps:

AWS (EC2, VPC, ALB, S3, CloudFront, SSM), Docker, CI/CD, Zero-Downtime Deployments, Git

Security:

JWT, OAuth 2.0, AES Encryption,DigiLocker KYC, OWASP Top 10, RBAC, Rate Limiting

Payments:

Razorpay, PhonePe, PayU ,OCR Verification (Tesseract, Google Cloud Vision), Webhooks

Blockchain:

Smart Contracts, Custodial Wallets, Token Swaps, Web3.js, Ethers.js, MetaMask, Binance BEP20

Observability:

Distributed Tracing, Application Logging

Secondary:

WebSockets, Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions, Push Notifications), Formik, Yup, Mailgun, SendGrid, Amazon SES, AdMob

AI & LLM:

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), LangChain, Gemini API, Qdrant (Vector DB), Prompt Engineering, Embedding Pipelines, AI Chatbot Development

Tools:

Postman, Swagger, VS Code, GitHub, GitLab

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Full Stack Engineer | GALAXY TECH SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED Jul 2026 – Present AI Marketing & Business Agency Platform | Hyderabad | On-site

• Building Business AI, a monorepo-based AI marketing platform — a complete business & marketing agency solution for managing

social media, campaigns, client workspaces, analytics, and team collaboration from a single platform.

Built AI-powered content generation features — including AI poster and AI video generation — with LLM integration across multiple services.

Building the Next.js frontend consuming Fastify-based backend microservices, with each service dedicated to a specific platform capability.

Implemented individual and agency workspace switching — enabling users to move seamlessly between personal and agency-managed contexts.

Tech Stack: Next.js, Fastify, Node.js, Microservices, LLM Integration, AI Content Generation, REST APIs

Full Stack Engineer | JAISVIK SOFTWARE SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED Apr 2025 – Jun 2026 Crypto Fintech | On-site | Promoted from Associate Web Developer

Promoted to lead all system design, AWS infrastructure, and architecture decisions for the platform. • Designed event-driven architecture with BullMQ, DLQ & retry logic → reduced transaction failures by 30%. • Built Redis caching layer across APIs → cut DB load by 40%, response time by 50%. • Engineered JMC Mining System (3-phase: Normal → Recovery → Resurrection) → zero revenue loss during outages. • Designed J-Wallet custodial wallet — AES-encrypted key storage, BEP20 deposits, token swaps. • Built OCR-based payment verification across Razorpay, PhonePe, PayU → eliminated manual reconciliation. • Deployed highly available AWS stack (EC2, ALB, VPC, S3, CloudFront, SSM) — zero-downtime deployments. • Built real-time internal community chat system using WebSockets — enabling live peer messaging across the platform. • Integrated Firebase push notification system for mining status updates and real-time platform announcements — delivered instantly to all active users.

Owned full product lifecycle — design, deployment, monitoring, and incident resolution. • Built a production RAG-based AI customer support chatbot , LangChain ,Gemini ,Qdrant vector DB — developed as a live chat widget on jaimax.com for 24/7 automated user support.

Sole engineer — owned full backend (REST APIs, DB schemas, auth, RBAC, payroll, PDF pipelines) and frontend. • Built React.js + Tailwind CSS UI for HR, Admin, Manager, and Employee roles with granular access control. • Integrated Firebase push notifications for real-time logout alerts and session-expiry warnings across all employee roles. • Delivered: Attendance, Leave management, Payslip generation, dynamic letter PDF export, Feedback & Document modules. Tech Stack: Node.js, FastAPI, BullMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, React.js, WebSockets, Firebase, Ethers.js, Web3.js, LangChain, Gemini API, Qdrant Associate Web Developer | JAISVIK SOFTWARE SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED Apr 2024 – Mar 2025 Crypto Fintech | On-site

Delivered end-to-end KYC, payments, dashboards, and backend automation for a live crypto product. • Built DigiLocker KYC automation → real-time identity verification, Indian regulatory compliance. • Integrated Razorpay & PhonePe — secure transaction handling, webhook processing, automated reconciliation. • Designed BullMQ job queues with dedicated workers for mining ops, background tasks, and scheduling. • Applied Redis distributed locking → eliminated race conditions in concurrent mining workflows. • Migrated payment & order services from monolith to microservices with secure proxy routing. • Built RBAC role dashboards, RTK Query API integrations, and dynamic PDF reporting UI.

Tech Stack: Node.js, Express.js, BullMQ, Redis, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, React.js, RTK Query, DigiLocker API

Full Stack Developer | DIGITALLY VIBE Sep 2024 – May 2026 Digital Technology Agency | Remote | Self-employed

Designed and shipped College Circle (MERN) and Thrivewell Healthcare (Next.js) from architecture to production. • College Circle: Firebase Auth, Cloud Functions, real-time sync, RBAC, Redux/RTK — live at collegecircle.cc. • Thrivewell: SEO-optimized Next.js platform with Firestore real-time admin dashboard — live at thrivewell-healthcare.in. • Enforced OAuth 2.0, protected routes, secure API communication, and CI/CD pipelines throughout. Tech Stack: React.js, Redux/RTK, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Firebase Auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions KEY PROJECTS

▸ Jaimax Coin – Crypto Ecosystem & Automation Platform ( JAISVIK SOFTWARE SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED)

• 10,000+ active users • 80,000+ daily events • Razorpay, PhonePe, PayU multi-gateway payments.

• J-Wallet: AES-encrypted custodial wallet, BEP20 deposits, token swaps • failures reduced by 30% via event-driven BullMQ

architecture.

Real-time internal community chat via WebSockets • Firebase push notifications for mining updates and platform announcements.

Full observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Promtail • Zero-downtime AWS deployment.

Tech Stack: Node.js, BullMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS (EC2, ALB, VPC, S3), React.js, WebSockets, Firebase, Web3.js Live: https://www.jaimax.com

▸ Jaimax AI Customer Support Chatbot — RAG Pipeline ( JAISVIK SOFTWARE SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED)

Built a production RAG-based AI customer support chatbot deployed as a live chat widget on jaimax.com — handling user queries on platform FAQs, wallet usage, mining, and payment support.

Architected the full RAG pipeline using LangChain + Gemini — document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, semantic retrieval via Qdrant vector DB, and response synthesis.

Built FastAPI backend to serve the RAG pipeline with streaming responses — integrated as a React.js chat widget live on the platform, available 24/7 to all users.

Eliminated repetitive manual support queries — instant AI-powered answers grounded in verified Jaimax documentation with zero hallucinations via Qdrant semantic retrieval.

Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, LangChain, Gemini API, Qdrant, React.js, Prompt Engineering, Embedding Pipelines Live: https://www.jaimax.com

▸ Jaimax Force – Internal HRMS Portal ( JAISVIK SOFTWARE SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED)

Sole engineer (backend , frontend) — REST APIs, RBAC, payroll engine, PDF generation — entire org uses it daily. • Modules: Attendance, Leave, Payslip, Salary, Letter generation (PDF), Feedback, Document verification.

Tech Stack: Node.js, Express.js, React.js, Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, JWT Live: https://www.force.jaimax.com

ADDITIONAL PROJECTS

▸ College Circle – Student Collaboration Platform

Cross-institution MERN platform: resource sharing, communities, real-time messaging, event discovery. • Firebase Auth, Cloud Functions, RBAC (student/contributor/admin), Redux/RTK, optimized MongoDB schemas.

Tech Stack: React.js, Redux/RTK, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Firebase Auth, Firebase Cloud Functions Live: https://www.collegecircle.cc

▸ Thrivewell Healthcare – Full Stack Web Application

Next.js healthcare platform — appointment booking, SEO-optimized interface, real-time Firestore admin dashboard. • Fast load times, clean UI/UX, scalable architecture for reliable digital healthcare delivery.

Tech Stack: Next.js, Firebase Firestore, Tailwind CSS, Firebase Cloud Functions Live: https://www.thrivewell-healthcare.in

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Full Stack Engineer | GALAXY TECH SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED Jul 2026 – Present AI Marketing & Business Agency Platform | Hyderabad | On-site
• Building Business AI, a monorepo-based AI marketing platform — a complete business & marketing agency solution for managing
social media, campaigns, client workspaces, analytics, and team collaboration from a single platform.
Built AI-powered content generation features — including AI poster and AI video generation — with LLM integration across multiple services.
Building the Next.js frontend consuming Fastify-based backend microservices, with each service dedicated to a specific platform capability.
Implemented individual and agency workspace switching — enabling users to move seamlessly between personal and agency-managed contexts.
Tech Stack: Next.js, Fastify, Node.js, Microservices, LLM Integration, AI Content Generation, REST APIs
Full Stack Engineer | JAISVIK SOFTWARE SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED Apr 2025 – Jun 2026 Crypto Fintech | On-site | Promoted from Associate Web Developer
Promoted to lead all system design, AWS infrastructure, and architecture decisions for the platform. • Designed event-driven architecture with BullMQ, DLQ & retry logic → reduced transaction failures by 30%. • Built Redis caching layer across APIs → cut DB load by 40%, response time by 50%. • Engineered JMC Mining System (3-phase: Normal → Recovery → Resurrection) → zero revenue loss during outages. • Designed J-Wallet custodial wallet — AES-encrypted key storage, BEP20 deposits, token swaps. • Built OCR-based payment verification across Razorpay, PhonePe, PayU → eliminated manual reconciliation. • Deployed highly available AWS stack (EC2, ALB, VPC, S3, CloudFront, SSM) — zero-downtime deployments. • Built real-time internal community chat system using WebSockets — enabling live peer messaging across the platform. • Integrated Firebase push notification system for mining status updates and real-time platform announcements — delivered instantly to all active users.
Owned full product lifecycle — design, deployment, monitoring, and incident resolution. • Built a production RAG-based AI customer support chatbot , LangChain ,Gemini ,Qdrant vector DB — developed as a live chat widget on jaimax.com for 24/7 automated user support.
Sole engineer — owned full backend (REST APIs, DB schemas, auth, RBAC, payroll, PDF pipelines) and frontend. • Built React.js + Tailwind CSS UI for HR, Admin, Manager, and Employee roles with granular access control. • Integrated Firebase push notifications for real-time logout alerts and session-expiry warnings across all employee roles. • Delivered: Attendance, Leave management, Payslip generation, dynamic letter PDF export, Feedback & Document modules. Tech Stack: Node.js, FastAPI, BullMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, React.js, WebSockets, Firebase, Ethers.js, Web3.js, LangChain, Gemini API, Qdrant Associate Web Developer | JAISVIK SOFTWARE SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED Apr 2024 – Mar 2025 Crypto Fintech | On-site
Delivered end-to-end KYC, payments, dashboards, and backend automation for a live crypto product. • Built DigiLocker KYC automation → real-time identity verification, Indian regulatory compliance. • Integrated Razorpay & PhonePe — secure transaction handling, webhook processing, automated reconciliation. • Designed BullMQ job queues with dedicated workers for mining ops, background tasks, and scheduling. • Applied Redis distributed locking → eliminated race conditions in concurrent mining workflows. • Migrated payment & order services from monolith to microservices with secure proxy routing. • Built RBAC role dashboards, RTK Query API integrations, and dynamic PDF reporting UI.
Tech Stack: Node.js, Express.js, BullMQ, Redis, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, React.js, RTK Query, DigiLocker API
Full Stack Developer | DIGITALLY VIBE Sep 2024 – May 2026 Digital Technology Agency | Remote | Self-employed
Designed and shipped College Circle (MERN) and Thrivewell Healthcare (Next.js) from architecture to production. • College Circle: Firebase Auth, Cloud Functions, real-time sync, RBAC, Redux/RTK — live at collegecircle.cc. • Thrivewell: SEO-optimized Next.js platform with Firestore real-time admin dashboard — live at thrivewell-healthcare.in. • Enforced OAuth 2.0, protected routes, secure API communication, and CI/CD pipelines throughout. Tech Stack: React.js, Redux/RTK, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Firebase Auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions

Eliminated repetitive manual support queries — instant AI-powered answers grounded in verified Jaimax documentation with zero hallucinations via Qdrant semantic retrieval.

Tech Stack: Node.js, Express.js, React.js, Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, JWT Live: https://www.force.jaimax.com

Next.js healthcare platform — appointment booking, SEO-optimized interface, real-time Firestore admin dashboard. • Fast load times, clean UI/UX, scalable architecture for reliable digital healthcare delivery.
Tech Stack: Next.js, Firebase Firestore, Tailwind CSS, Firebase Cloud Functions Live: https://www.thrivewell-healthcare.in
